",
  "evidence": "The failing check not_null_fct_orders_region_name reported 14744 null region_name values in marts.fct_orders. fct_orders gets region_name from dim_customers via a left join on customer_key. dim_customers only has 24 rows and no null region_name, indicating most customers are missing from dim_customers. The dim_customers model incorrectly joins stg_customers to stg_nations on c.customer_key = n.nation_key and uses an inner join to stg_regions, causing most rows to be dropped. Correcting the join to c.nation_key = n.nation_key and using left joins preserves all customers, eliminating null region_name in fct_orders and fixing the failing test."
}
